newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline up sharply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline up sharply.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday morning, gasoline up sharply from Friday's close, while fuel oil softened, dealers said.

Gasoline was firmer, as well as being the only product to register morning deals. Rotterdam refinery material sold at $190.25 fob and a trading house bought two eurograde barges at $192.50 and $193 fob AR.
Some traders expressed surprise at the strength of the latter two deals.
"It really is very high. It puts the crack at 40 cents more than on Friday," one trader said.
By late morning, the trading house was not in the market, traders said, leaving the best bids at around $188 fob.

Heating oil was broadly unchanged in a very thin market. IPE August gas oil futures after taking 20 minutes to reach a first trade. Prompt offers remained at IPE August +$1. A national holiday in Belgium contributed to the quiet start.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were also untraded in the first few hours of business. Quotes of $87/$89 fob Rotterdam represented a loss of about $1 a tonne.
"That's reasonable -- certainly not bad for a Monday," one dealer said. -- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004
